plain: To cancel a law or make it have no force

webster.text: To annul; to make void; to render invalid; to deprive of legal force or efficacy.

example.quote: that every State has a natural right in cases not within the compact, (casus non foederis,) to nullify of their own authority all assumptions of power by others within their limits:
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, Draft of the Kentucky Resolutions, Oct. 1798
